additional_info.subject: ID0380458-DC/Si-D/EE- [MP / P9 170000984] - After chademo session OCPP stuck in finishing CRM:00315001817
additional_info.body:
Dear Markus,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P9 170000984
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
1p1SHV, 8SZY9F
Problem Description
: Connector 1 stays in Finishing for 45mins, this makes the outlet unavailable to charge during this time.
Troubleshooting
:
As we already aligned last week, these 2 chargers are having problems with the connector availability.
I cross-checked the logs from DC1 and DC2, it appears that this is only happening in DC1 with Chademo. It's clear that the problem is the SECC since it's the one that sends these notifications.
If possible, let's schedule a charging session with the customer where I can live check the EcoG state logs. From the logs, the only permanent solution I can offer is to replace the EcoG.
My suggestion would be to schedule the test session and have a EcoG on-site to replace in case necessary. What is your opinion?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0380458
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

replying

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380458-DC/Si-D/EE- [MP / P9 170000984] - After chademo session OCPP stuck in finishing CRM:00315001817
additional_info.body:
Hi,
Scheduling charging session is difficult and more difficult because it is Chademo. This has happened now already in two locations, so I think it’s more software related topic?
But anyway, I think the easiest solution is just to replace EcoG and continue monitoring after that if the problem was solved or not.
Markus

additional_info.subject: ID0380458-DC/Si-D/EE- [MP / P9 170000984] - After chademo session OCPP stuck in finishing CRM:00315001817
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus, good afternoon.
Quick feedback on this topic.
There is a docker that is responsible for sending this information from EcoG. As such, I will forward this to the Experts for further analysis.
For now, let's not replace the EcoG yet. They will align with you for further tests.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
